title: Simple Status
description: Adds a status in front of the player's name
body:
**Simple Status Plugin by kxksi**

![You can set any status imaginable](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/121e8cc748ad1302a5dfbadd8770e796677fcb43_0.webp)

**Commands:**
- /status <Status> - Sets a separate status in front of the player's name
- /status <OFF> - Switches the status off

The status defined by the player is saved.
